{{Quote|This is Lieutenant Esture. We just had a droid we were examining do a firmware meltdown and we need to talk to its supervisor."|Esture|<ref name="Death Star" />}}
'''Esture''' was a a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] who was stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].

==Biography==
===The Battle of Yavin===
{{Quote|Flight control.''"''<br />''"''Flight control? The comm station must have given me the wrong connection. Sorry.|Atour Riten and Esture|<ref name="Death Star" />}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Esture was stationed on [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|the first Death Star]] where he checked on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[P-RC3]], who had a memory breakdown during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He called [[Atour Riten]], the Death Star's librarian and owner of the droid, but was tricked into believing he instead called flight control by mistake, when Riten answered as such, due to him being in a desertion attempt.<ref name="Death Star" />

He was killed afterwards when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] attacking the Death Star managed to cause the battlestation to explode, killing everyone onboard.<ref name="Death Star" />
